objective: Implement deterministic restart/crash recovery planning from a content-addressed exact P21-A canonical position checkpoint plus an exact P21-F reconciliation report, allowing recovery only after MATCHED reconciliation and failing safe without automatic broker/OMS/canonical mutation.
scope: Represent exact content-addressed recovery checkpoints for canonical P21-A position records
Recompute checkpoint content hashes and exact position_record_id before any recovery decision
Bind recovery to an exact P21-F reconciliation report for the same position record
Allow deterministic recoverable disposition only when P21-F verdict is MATCHED
Force SAFE_HOLD + NEW_ENTRY_BLOCK + MANUAL_GOVERNED_RECOVERY_REQUIRED for every non-MATCHED reconciliation
Reject corrupted, stale or cross-position checkpoint/report bindings
Produce deterministic content-addressed recovery plans and byte-identical P21-G evidence
out_of_scope: Automatic broker, OMS or canonical-position mutation
Credential, account, KYC or funding operations
tests: Matched exact checkpoint plus P21-F MATCHED report is recoverable
Any P21-F mismatch forces SAFE_HOLD + NEW_ENTRY_BLOCK + manual governed recovery
Corrupted checkpoint content hash fails closed
Checkpoint payload must exactly reproduce position_record_id
Recovery plan is deterministic and byte-identical across two evidence runs
No automatic position/OMS mutation, venue query, external order or Live authority is emitted
rollback: Revert P21-G package/config/tests/evidence/CI/state changes; P21-A through P21-F remain canonical complete and P21-H remains unstarted.
definition_of_done: Strict CI and deterministic evidence pass
Implementation PR merged and post-merge verified
